description.en: MiMo's 30-day Token Plan usage and model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 MiMo 30 天 Token Plan 用量及模型目录。

description.en: Add the serving key and, optionally, console cookies for quota refresh. With the account cookie the plugin renews the 24-hour console session itself.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新额度的控制台 Cookie；提供账号 Cookie 后插件会自动续期 24 小时的控制台会话。

help_text.en: Optional. Cookie block for platform.xiaomimimo.com (DevTools → Application → Cookies). The console session expires after 24 hours; pair it with the account cookie below and the plugin renews it automatically every 12 hours.
help_text.zh: 可选。platform.xiaomimimo.com 域的 Cookie（开发者工具 → Application → Cookies 复制）。控制台会话 24 小时过期；配合下方账号 Cookie 后插件每 12 小时自动续期。

help_text.en: Optional but recommended. Cookie block for account.xiaomi.com (passToken, userId, cUserId, deviceId — copy from DevTools). The passToken stays valid about 30 days and lets the plugin mint a fresh console cookie through the same SSO flow the website uses, so quota keeps refreshing after the 24-hour console session expires.
help_text.zh: 可选但推荐。account.xiaomi.com 域的 Cookie（passToken、userId、cUserId、deviceId，开发者工具中复制）。passToken 约 30 天有效，插件用它走与网页相同的 SSO 流程自动换取新的控制台 Cookie，24 小时会话过期后额度仍能自动刷新。

label.zh: 小米账号 Cookie（自动续期）
